title: Let "get the popover stack position" take null
body: "Topmost clicked popover" passes the results of "nearest inclusive open popover" and "nearest inclusive target popover" to "get the popover stack position". Either can be null, for example when the click is outside every popover, but "get the popover stack position" only accepted an HTML element. Make it accept null and return 0, which is lower than the position of any showing auto or hint popover, so the existing comparison in "topmost clicked popover" gives the same result as before. Also state that "topmost clicked popover" returns an HTML element or null. All three engines already handle null here and agree with this change for every reachable case; this just makes the spec say what they do.
